title: [Radio’Clock] KOREAPEDIA with GHOST9 #A museum without a roof! Gyeongju
description:
신라의 수도로 문화가 많이 남아있는 경주를 함께 했는데요
교과서에서 보던 사진 그대로의 모습을 간직하고 있는 불국사, 석굴암, 다보탑과 석가탑.
그리고 지진에서도 살아남은 과학적으로 지어진 첨성대까지!
다들 한 번쯤 그 앞에서 사진 찍어본 기억,, 있으시죠?

문화재 역사뿐만 아니라, 음식에도 역사가 남아있는데요
1939 한국 최초의 팥빵으로 알려진 경주 황남빵!

역사만 있는 건 아니죠!
스릴 넘쳐보이는 놀이기구들도 있는데요!

교육적으로도 좋고, 놀기에도 좋은 경주!
그 매력을 천천히 알아가봐요!

We explored Gyeongju this week,
a city that has preserved a lot of its cultural heritage as the former capital of the Silla Dynasty.
We encountered the sights that we had seen in textbooks,
such as Bulguksa Temple, Seokguram Grotto, Dabotap, Seokgatap,
and last but not least Cheomseongdae,
a scientifically constructed astronomical observatory that has survived earthquakes.
You probably have taken a photo in front of these iconic landmarks at least once before!

Not only does Gyeongju possess cultural heritage and history,
but it also boasts a rich culinary tradition.
One notable example is Gyeongju Hwangnam Bread,
known as the first red bean bread in Korea, dating back to 1939.

But Gyeongju isn't just about history and food!
It offers thrilling amusement park rides as well.

Gyeongju is a city that is both educational and enjoyable,
so let's continue to discover its charms at a leisurely pace!
